$comment: Test set for the AI port. Each case: <name>.txt (input text), <name>.response.json (the mock's answer),
<name>.expected.json (what pnpm eval:ai checks), optionally <name>.jsonld.json (JSON-LD sent with the text)
and <name>.png (the same recipe as an image). 'default' is the mock's answer for unknown input.
'reserved' inputs make the mock fail with that error code, for tests of the error messages.
'reservedImages' do the same for a photo: the mock keys them on the image bytes, so a PNG that the client sends as it is (it already fits) reaches the mock unchanged.
koket-* and tasteline-* are the saved pages in tests/fixtures/sites/ as the import flow reads them (extractRecipePage); extract.test.ts keeps them in step.

'suggest' is the case suggestDishes answers with: suggest-dishes.response.json (the model's answer, three recipes), suggest-dishes.pantry.json (the input pnpm eval:ai sends) and suggest-dishes.expected.json (what it checks). Whatever is at home, the mock answers the first of 'suggest' and 'suggestAlternatives' (suggest-dishes-andra.response.json) that has none of the titles to avoid, else ai_invalid; a pantry item named like a 'reserved' text (ai_unavailable, ai_invalid, ai_rejected) makes it fail with that code.

'analyze' is what analyzeImage answers: each case is a synthetic photo <name>.png (drawn by scripts/render-pantry-image.mjs, never a real photo, since the repo is public) and the model's answer <name>.analyze.json. The mock keys the photo on its bytes; any other photo gets 'default'. The reserved images for ai_unavailable, ai_invalid and ai_rejected give those codes; reserved-import_no_recipe.png gets the default answer. kyl-dorr (Story 6.5) is a fridge door: a brand label the model repeats four times (merged by parseAnalyzeItems, as for a real model), a juice and a partly hidden bottle with confidence osäker.

'locate' is what locateItems answers (Story 6.6): <name>.locate.json holds the points Qwen3.6 in LM Studio gave for the photo <name>.png and its items in reading order (after the merge), in thousandths, as the model answers. The mock keys the photo on its bytes; any other photo gets 'default', and a point beyond the labels sent is left out. The reserved images give the same codes as for analyze.
